_comment: momentum_app: published intraday momentum rules, tested as published (nothing tuned here). The headline is the noise-area breakout of Zarattini, Aziz and Barbon, 'Beat the Market: An Effective Intraday Momentum Strategy for S&P500 ETF (SPY)', May 2024: 19.6% a year net, Sharpe 1.33, 2007 to 2024, on SPY. Development and validation overlap the paper's own years, so for SPY they are a replication; QQQ and IWM weren't in it. The holdout starts the month it was published: its rules hadn't seen any of it. Fixed 2026-11-15.
_noise_area_comment: The paper's rules, the defaults for every variant: each minute's usual move from the open is its average over lookback_days days; the band is max(open, yesterday's close) x (1 + band_multiplier x it) above and min(...) x (1 - ...) below. Checked every check_minutes from 10:00 to 15:30: above the band long, below short; out when back through the band or (vwap_stop) the day's VWAP; all sold at the close. Sized at min(max_leverage, target_daily_volatility / the last lookback_days' daily volatility) of the account. Fills at the open of the minute after a check. Costs per fill: cost_per_share (Alpaca charges no commission; half SPY's one-cent spread) plus slippage_percent; regulatory fees on sales. The paper assumed $0.0045 a share.
_variants_comment: Each on each symbol. The control for each: its own trades, same times, sizes and prices, in random directions. last_half_hour (Gao, Han, Li and Zhou 2018): at 15:30 the way it moved from yesterday's close to 10:00, to the close. overnight: bought at the close, sold at the open.
